_meta.description: Top-box share of the WHOLE base on a weighted crosstab. ATTR_CODE_IN turns the categorical converted field into a per-row 1/0 indicator (1 when the row's label is one of params.codes, here just "yes"; a null converted reads 0 and stays in the base), named by label. AGG_WEIGHTED_MEAN of that indicator in each region x treatment cell, weighted by session_minutes, is the weighted share of every row in the cell that converted. Contrast FILTER_INCLUDE on the same codes: it drops the non-matching rows, so every cell would read 100%. Categorical codes match dictionary labels, never ids; the attribute is row-local, so the crosstab scan stays fused and streamable.
_meta.name: attr_code_in_top_box
